title: Pander
summary: PAN'DER, noun [Latin mango.] A pimp, a procurer; a male bawd; a mean profligate wretch who caters for the lust of others. PAN'DER, verb transitive To pimp; to procure lewd women for others. PAN'DER, v

inlines.v: PAN'DER, noun [Latin mango.] A pimp, a procurer; a male bawd; a mean profligate wretch who caters for the lust of others. PAN'DER, verb transitive To pimp; to procure lewd women for others. PAN'DER, verb intransitive To act as agent for the lusts of others. 1. To be subservient to lust or passion.
